process_correction.what: the batch was initially set up with no review contract, on the reasoning that translation_contextual_v1 is the wrong instrument for a mechanical rename
process_correction.why_wrong: that reasoning was half-right. translation_contextual_v1 does review translation candidates for semantic fidelity and is indeed inapplicable, but ai_state_check requires every DONE task to carry a review contract with a bound, archived completion record. The correct instrument is code_legacy_v1 / normal_review - a diff review
process_correction.resolution: waiver retracted in STATE, code_legacy_v1 review dispatched and passed, candidate bound by spec_path + diff_path with candidate_ref = SHA256(SPEC || NUL || diff)
process_correction.note: satisfying the checker by inventing a contract name was available and was rejected - it is the same antipattern this task's own briefing warned the executor against regarding the 711-row assertion
